_about: Size limits for the files that steer Claude, from Anthropic's published docs plus our own house rules. Read by /suggest check 4b and /check's Holistic lens when a proposal grows a covered file, and later by the GEN-886 size sweep. Change it only in an attended session (Erez present), and re-verify each value against its source when you do.

counting.characters: Unicode code points, as wc -m counts them
counting.charsPerTokenSource: One sample: the Read tool counted wrap/SKILL.md at 25,221 tokens at about 70,000 characters (GEN-882). Conservative: prose usually runs higher. GEN-886 calibrates it.
counting.nearLimit: Within 10% of a limit is a near-limit note, not a breach.

limits.appliesTo: Each text a hook injects (additionalContext, systemMessage, plain stdout), so for ~/.claude/hooks/refs/*.md the injected payload, including any header the hook adds
limits.overIt: Claude sees only a file path and a preview of the first 2,000 characters, and is not asked to read the file. No setting raises it.
After auto-compaction only the first 5,000 tokens are re-attached; the rest of the runbook is lost. All re-attached skills share 25,000 tokens, most recent first.
Move detailed reference material to separate files.
Truncated in the skill listing, so the trigger wording past the cap never reaches Claude.
Over the Agent Skills format maximum; fine in Claude Code, but report it as a note.

limits.appliesTo: Every CLAUDE.md Claude loads (global and each project's)
limits.overIt: Consumes more context in every session and reduces adherence. Report characters too: long lines make the line count understate the cost.

limits.measure: lines or bytes, whichever comes first
limits.overIt: Content past the threshold is not loaded at session start.

limits.appliesTo: Each .md file other than SKILL.md under ~/.claude/skills/*/
limits.overIt: Over 100 lines, start the file with a table of contents so a partial read still shows its scope.

houseRules.appliesTo: SKILL.md of vet-rule, vet-code, vet-ticket and wrap
houseRules.overIt: Our own cap from GEN-845, stated in each of those files, to keep each runbook safely under the 5,000-token compaction limit. New detail goes in a reference file.
houseRules.source: GEN-845; stated in each file's own text
